chapters.title: First Play to Obsession
chapters.hook: A listener skims widely on a laptop and an iPod before the library collapses into one band.
chapters.motif: Desktop and web players dominate early; 2015 alone carries 610 distinct artists and a 78.7% skip rate, with a median play of just 14 seconds. This is browsing, not listening.

chapters.title: The Beatles Regime
chapters.hook: One band takes over, Android becomes the default device, and skipping stops almost entirely.
chapters.motif: The Beatles account for 5250 of 41137 plays in this span, and the skip rate is 0.0%. Android carries 94% of all plays. The household ledger runs in parallel for every month of this chapter.

chapters.title: The Lockdown Divide
chapters.hook: Repertoire doubles, soundtracks arrive, and listening moves to speakers and screens.
chapters.motif: Distinct artists rise from 733 to 1,515. Howard Shore appears 213 times in October 2020 alone, and 'cast to device' jumps from 106 plays to 3,773.

chapters.title: A Second Language
chapters.hook: Spanish-language songwriting enters the library and becomes a permanent strand.
chapters.motif: Joaquín Sabina is first played 2021-08-20 and reaches 796 plays; a Spanish strand of 2,294 plays spans six artists. A Mac appears in 2023 as a second listening device.
